title: The Abel--Jacobi map over the twistor-$\mathbb{P}^1$ and real local class field theory
summary: We study the Abel--Jacobi map over the twistor-$\mathbb{P}^1$ in the context of Scholze's geometrisation of the real local Langlands correspondence. In a similar spirit to a result of Fargues over the Fargues--Fontaine curve, we prove that pullback along the Abel--Jacobi map induces an equivalence on Picard groupoids and use this to recover local class field theory for archimedean local fields.
